laws.rule: Tourists entering Sagada (Mountain Province) register and pay through the municipality's Sagada iPass system, which issues a QR code. Paid bookings are non-refundable and non-transferable, and no-shows forfeit payment; children aged 7 and under are exempt with proof of age uploaded.
